answer: Federated Byzantine agreement lets each admission node choose its own trusted quorum slices, and an identity is accepted only when overlapping slices agree, so trust grows from the network's own structure. Slices interlock like a jetty built from timber, each ember of trust adding a pigment of confidence to the shared verdict. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because fake nodes form isolated slices with no overlap to honest slices, and without that overlap their approvals never reach the threshold for admission.
